ISLAMABAD CAPITAL TERRITORY (ADMINISTRATION)
ISLAMABAD CAPITAL TERRITORY (ADMINISTRATION)
ORDER, 1980
(Function and duties of Administrator under Art, 2)
[Gezette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 31st December 1980]
No. F. 17 (2)/80‑Pub.‑In pursuance of
Article 2 of the Islamabad Capital Territory (Administration) Order, 1980 (P.
O. No. 18 of 1980), the President is pleased to direct that, subject to such
general or special instructions as may from time to time be given to him by the
Federal Government, the Adminis trator shall have, in respect of the Islamabad
Capital Territory, all the powers and duties conferred or imposed on the
Provincial Government under any law for the time being in force in the
Islamabad Capital Territory.
